[[Musako Tu’ro]] is a young girl who is fond of [[Yuimo the Mime]]. She wants to be a mime too when she's grown up. She is accompanied by her mother [[Tanrieo Tu’ro]].

Together with her mother and Yuimo the Mime, she belongs to a little [[Wajjun Bazaar#Dialogues|sketch]]. They seem to  appear only on random occasions.
